hostInfo.welcomeMessage:
Haemer Villa is situated halfway between Cua Dai beach and Hoi An Ancient Town, where you could take tours around the beautiful hidden countryside as well by bicycle, enjoy the sunshine on the beach, and visit Hoi An ancient town to see the old houses hundreds of year ago and floating lantern on Hoai river, a particular highlight in Hoi An.
Haemer Villa has a total of 14 fully equipped rooms with a private balcony, providing lovely views over the Co Co river or emerald green rice fields.
The front yard restaurant affords a peaceful setting overlooking the river and serves traditional Vietnamese cuisine, cold beer, and ” Fish and chips”,…
Our outdoor swimming pool and sun terrace are the ideal places to relax after a busy day.

About this space:
– 1,5 km from Cua Dai Beach; 3km from An Bàng beach; 2,5km from the Old town; 2km from Eco Discovery Coconut Water Forest;….
– Local restaurants & markets within 10′ walking
– Nice swimming pool, BBQ area
– We offer full service for your trip: visa on arrival, day tour, airport pick up, internet sim card & flight ticket all around Vietnam

hostInfo.name: Ayatana Homes & Gardens
hostInfo.welcomeMessage:
Nested on a tranquil and picturesque river bank, Anicca villa is ideally situated between Hoi An heritage ancient town and many nearby beaches, offering easy access to many attractions. The surrounding friendly natural environment offers an authentic experience of living in a local green village filled with an eco-conscious and zen spirit. Away from the hustle and bustle of daily life, the villa is an ideal accommodation for a family vacation or an unforgettable holiday retreat with friends.

Walking through the house’s gate, ease your eyes with a large plunge pool and a 1,000m2 blooming garden. Take a dip in our plunge pool or head to a beach, bike through rice paddies or kayak through water coconut forest, take a stroll in the ancient town or simply enjoy gorgeous sunset from your room window. The house offers 5 separate air-conditioned bedrooms, 3 have en-suite bathrooms, the 2 other bedrooms share a bathroom, sleeping up to 10 guests. Each room is well-equipped with large windows and private patios overlooking to the garden, the pool or the river. An open living room connects to a fully furnished kitchen and a large wooden dining table in a huge veranda overlooking the green garden. A lot of additional seating areas, both indoors and outdoors, to sit down for a sip of drink and start a conversation or just chill out while watching the sun rise and set from the skyline horizon.

At the pool side, there are 4 lounge beds with umbrellas and a spacious deck which is a perfect place for an early morning yoga. After a swim, take a cold drink, have some snack or just relax in a shaded bamboo cabana.

The villa is 5 minute driving to Hoi An ancient town and 4 minute to the beach. Local restaurants and coffee shops are within walking or biking distance.
hostInfo.ownerInfo: We are Ayatana Homes & Gardens - the management team of several private vacation homes and villas in Hoi An. It’s been always our pleasure to get to know new people from all over the world and share our experience with those who visit this lovely town. Welcome to our homes/villas!!!

hostInfo.name: Lan Phuong
hostInfo.welcomeMessage:
The house is located in the middle between An Bang beach (4 minutes for biking) and the old town center (10 minutes for biking). The room is featured fully as a 4 star hotel as well. It's perfect to make a plan to go everywhere in Hoi An.

We provide FREE wifi, use of swimming pool, bicycles rental. There is also a lift inside. It's perfect for people having an issue climbing stairs. And you can also relax at the end of the day on the rooftop terrace with the beautiful view of Tra Que vegetable village- A famous tourist attraction in Hoi An.
We also serve daily breakfast with a good price VND 90.000/pax/day with delicious local cuisine foods and drinks. We will advise more info when you arrive.
_welcome to my house_
hostInfo.ownerInfo: We are local people who are always hospitable and friendly. I am ready to help you at any time by calling or texting me.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo: Next to the Villa is the peaceful Tra Que Vegetable Village, where you can leisurely bike around in the afternoon. Within a short distance of less than 800 meters to An Bang Beach – a beautiful place with pubs and charming cafes on a long sandy beach. You can easily reach this spot by a 4-minute bike ride or 10-minutes a walk from the Villa.
